name: inw
description: inw performs a 16-bit (word-width) input from the specified I/O port. The inw_p variant pauses until the I/O operation completes. These functions are used for low-level hardware port access and require proper permissions via ioperm(2) or iopl(2).

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: The I/O port number to read from

return_value.success: Returns the value read from the port as an unsigned short
return_value.failure: May cause a segmentation fault if I/O permissions are not set

bugs: Functions are defined as inline macros and require compilation with optimization flags like -O or -O2; they are hardware-specific with argument order differing from most DOS implementations.
